title: The panel reads top to bottom the way the user expects: Layers on top, a draggable divider, no Library for images, plain switches
goal: Make the right panel predictable. Layers sits at the top of the panel. The picked thing's sections sit below it. The boundary between them is a divider the person can drag up and down, remembered. In image documents the Library is hidden unless the person turns it on (it is mostly for video and design). The Sections popover's switches are plain switches: no extra circular 'reset' icon beside each one.
notes:
User's words (2026-10-18): "the panes are totally confusing!!!! layers isn't at the top, i can't drag the pane up and down, library was expanded by default. I think for image editing it should be hidden. And this weird ux with the undo icon when i toggle a pane on? what the hell is that? there's no need to undo toggling a switch". Screenshots: (1) image doc: APPEARANCE, EFFECTS, MOTION collapsed at top, then LAYERS 17 (Size groups, Background, Canvas) in a pane with a large empty area, MEASUREMENTS 4, LIBRARY Components collapsed, Sections; (2) image doc with nothing picked: LAYERS 14 collapsed at the top and the rest of the panel empty, and the Sections popover showing Library 'Always hidden' and Measurements 'Always hidden' each with a circular arrow, plus Motion, Layout, Columns, Arrange, Component switches and 'Use Automatic for All'.

History: the card 'Where do Layers and Library sit when something is picked?' was resolved b 'Pick on top, lists in a pane at the bottom' (no note) and shipped 10-13; the-layers-and-library-pane-grows-into-any-room (done 10-18) made the pane fill room the sections leave, but the user still sees empty bands. Code: InspectorPanel.swift lists pane (inspector.listsPaneHeight, PanelListsPane), PanelSectionsFooter.swift Sections popover (reset icon :213). Memory: one purpose per area; never leave empty gaps the user cannot remove.
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults in an image document (the user's screenshots 2026-10-18 22.31.11 and 22.32.42): record the panel order (today Appearance/Effects/Motion on top, then LAYERS, MEASUREMENTS, LIBRARY in a bottom pane), whether the divider drags, the Library's default open state, the empty space under a collapsed Layers with nothing picked, and the circular arrow (arrow.counterclockwise, PanelSectionsFooter.swift:213) beside Library and Measurements in the Sections popover

Order, top to bottom: Layers (with its search), then Measurements when the document has any, then the picked thing's sections; the Library, when shown, is last. This reverses the 2026-10-13 card answer 'Pick on top, lists in a pane at the bottom' by the user's later word; update the UX-PATTERNS placement contract's Inspector row to say so

A visible divider between Layers and the sections below drags up and down with the resize cursor, live, clamped so each side keeps a minimum; its position is remembered per document kind; double click resets it

No empty bands: when Layers is collapsed or short, the sections below move up to meet it; when nothing is picked, Layers fills the panel (no blank area beneath a collapsed header); MEASURED gap 0 pt in every state

Library in image documents: hidden by default (absent from the panel), turned on from the Sections popover or View > Library; video and design documents keep their own default (video shows its catalog per the video library task)

Sections popover: each row is a name, a one-line state and a switch; the per-row circular reset icon is removed; the 'Use Automatic for All' link at the bottom stays as the one way back to automatic; switching a section on or off takes effect at once and needs no undo

A walk in an image document checks the order (Layers first), drags the divider and checks it moved and was remembered after reopening, checks the Library is absent by default, and checks the Sections popover has no reset icons
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Reproduced at Next defaults (Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/panel-grip-walk.json): with a layer picked the panel reads APPEARANCE, EFFECTS, MOTION on top and LAYERS 8 in a bottom pane (2-long-list-sc.png, Layers header at y=492 under Motion at y=573 in the panel reading); the pane grows into all the room the pick leaves, so ~130pt of blank glass sits under Canvas; the divider is a 1pt hairline with an invisible 9pt grab strip, nothing says it drags. Library: one app-wide setting (inspector.libraryVisible) that New UI Design, Make Component, Save Style and tutorials turn on and that then follows every image document; the Sections switch for Library cannot bring it back while that setting is off (the section is only offered when the setting is on). Sections popover draws arrow.counterclockwise beside every row with a choice (PanelSectionsFooter.swift:213).

Adversarial review before building: (1) clicking a layer row with nothing picked shrinks the Layers pane from the whole panel to its chosen height, so the clicked row could fall under the divider; LayersListView already brings the picked row back when its viewport shrinks (onChange of viewport, follow), so that holds. (2) A Photoshop user expects Properties above Layers, but the user's own word (2026-10-18) reverses their 10-13 card, and Figma/Sketch put the layer tree first; Layers on top it is. (3) The Layers list reserves room for rows a closed group COULD reveal; in a pane that hugs its content that reads as a blank band (the user's 17-layer screenshot), so in the pane it asks for its visible rows. (4) The divider today is a 1pt hairline: nothing says it drags; it needs a visible grabber. (5) On a video the timeline is the layer list, so the top pane is usually empty and the Library simply follows the pick's sections. (6) The Library visibility is one app-wide switch that design work turns on and then leaks into every picture; it has to be per window mode, and image/icon modes keep it hidden until turned on there.
owns these walks: panel-reads-top-to-bottom-walk, layers-divider-drags-by-pointer-walk, panel-grip-walk

Built: Core PanelListsPane rewritten (split -> lists on top [layers, measurements] / below [pick..., library last]; height hugs lists, whole column with nothing below; gripCeiling stops at the last row; heightKey(forKind:) per window mode), WindowMode.libraryWaitsToBeTurnedOn (Image, Icon) with tests. App: InspectorPanel draws pane, divider (ListsPaneGrip: 9pt strip with a 32x4 grabber, resize cursor, drag down grows, double click writes 0 = reset), then the scroller; Layers list in the pane asks for its visible rows; a folded Layers opens when nothing is picked; Library offered when the app-wide switch is on OR this mode turned it on, setLibraryVisible writes the mode's choice in Image/Icon; View > Library ticks isLibraryShown; Sections popover lost its per-row arrow.counterclockwise. Probe records every section in panel space plus the band under the divider; expectSections now fails when the part under the divider starts above the Layers pane; expectPaneGap measures blank inside the pane. Walks: new panel-reads-top-to-bottom-walk (no flags) and layers-divider-drags-by-pointer-walk (real mouse drag 333->253pt, double click back to 333, front:true); updated panel-grip, panel-shows-what-is-picked, library-shelf-height, layer-row-lifts-by-pointer (new fixed points); deleted lists-pane-fills-the-room-walk (its claim, a bottom pane growing into room the pick leaves, no longer exists). section-fold-motion-walk failed once on a 19.3ms pass then passed twice: a timing flake, not filed. Scripts/test.sh: 13740 tests passed. Left rough, not filed (each is an evaluate question or audit rough line the user can react to): the chip reads 'Image, edited' once the Library is turned on in a picture; the divider is remembered per window mode rather than per file type; the Library scrolls with the pick and keeps its own grab bar; opening a closed group grows the pane.

Layers and Measurements now sit in a pane at the top of the right panel with a visible divider (drag, remembered per window mode, double click resets), the picked layer's sections under it with no gap, the Library last; Library hidden in Image/Icon until turned on there; Sections list has plain switches.
